scripts.gcp: git add . && git commit -m "update" && git push
scripts.gcp:msg: node -e "const msg=process.argv.slice(1).join(' ')||'update'; const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const run=(cmd,args)=>{const r=spawnSync(cmd,args,{stdio:'inherit',shell:true}); if(r.status!==0) process.exit(r.status);}; run('git',['add','.']); run('git',['commit','-m',msg]); run('git',['push']);"
